Marc Deschamps has been writing about video games and popular culture for more than a decade. A reporter at GameRant, Marc has also been published at sites like IGN, Nintendojo, and ComicBook. Gaming is one of Marc's oldest loves, and he specializes in covering franchises like Pokemon, Zelda, and Mario. However, he also has a deep background when it comes to comics and movies. In addition to being a published comic writer, Marc is a Rotten Tomatoes-verified critic that has reviewed movies and interviewed directors, actors, and actresses.
While Marc has a passion for covering Nintendo franchises like Mario, Pokemon, Metroid, and Zelda, he also loves writing about Sonic, Resident Evil, and games based on comics. That passion has given him the opportunity to attend preview events, review major games, and interview industry figures such as Davide Soliani, Nate Bihldorff, and Yuri Lowenthal.
Marc's all-time favorite console is the Nintendo Switch. He has a collection of more than 100 physical games for the system, topping the substantial number he once owned for the GameCube.
Going to the movies is one of Marc's absolute favorite things to do. He has a love for horror and superhero movies in particular, but will see just about anything, sometimes without even watching a trailer first. His all-time favorite films include Halloween, Jurassic Park, Transformers: The Movie, Star Wars, Scream, Pulp Fiction, Dogma, Step Brothers, Spider-Man 2, and Captain America: The First Avenger.
The remake of Zelda: Ocarina of Time has several changes from the N64 version, and Nintendo highlights 8 that players can expect to see.
The original Scream has one element that helped make it classic, and none of the sequels have managed to recapture that same magic.
A Kirby Air Riders Halloween event ends much earlier than expected, as Nintendo explains why the decision was made for the Switch 2 game.
Pokemon GO developer Scopely Explore reveals the Dynamax Trails event, which sees the return of Eternatus and nearly every previous Dynamax Pokemon.
Dead by Daylight officially adds Art the Clown and Sienna as playable characters, best known for their roles in the Terrifier franchise.
Retailers are hosting midnight release parties for the Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, but one cancels events at all stores a week ahead of launch.
Nintendo announces a new event set to take place on Wednesday, October 28, revealing full details on how fans can tune in and watch.
Doctor Doom will cause chaos for the MCU in Avengers: Doomsday, but the character has a starring role in a new Marvel release arriving much sooner.
Pokemon GO developer Scopely Explore announces a November Community Day which will feature a beloved Pokemon from the Unova Region.
Electronic Arts confirms a new game in development from DICE and Respawn, and rumors claim that it's the long-awaited Star Wars Battlefront 3.
Fans of The Simpsons continue hoping for a remaster of Hit & Run, and there's an increased chance following a major event in the show.
Pokemon GO developer Scopely Explore reveals November's GO Pass rewards, which include a whole bunch of PokeCoins for players to obtain.
Nintendo takes it back to 1998 for the Switch 2 remake of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, paying tribute to a commercial released for the N64 version.
A classic Batman villain gets his own movie, but some fans might be confused about where and when it's supposed to take place.
Dark Link is one of the most iconic foes in Zelda: Ocarina of Time, and Nintendo offers a first look at the enemy in the upcoming remake.
The developers of Pokemon TCG Pocket announce big changes coming to the mobile game, as part of an effort to improve things for players.
Retailers are having midnight openings for the Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, and one is offering a nostalgic bonus for N64 fans.
Nintendo offers an official new look at Link and Navi from the upcoming remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2.
Mario Kart 8 Deluxe has a new update for the month of October, which is live on the original Switch, as well as Nintendo Switch 2.
After several delays, 007 First Light has a release date on Nintendo Switch 2, as well as a pre-order bonus that should excite Bond fans.
